In current-r3, get_symbol_context also reports unrelated Rust and TypeScript send signatures as dependencies of InvitationController.post. The fixture contains same-name functions in those languages, but no cross-language call chain; find_references correctly excludes those cross-language sites. Reviewed answers omit the false results. Reproduction evidence is current-r3/attempt-001/events.jsonl item_16, revised-r1/attempt-001/events.jsonl item_10, and revised-r3/attempt-001/events.jsonl item_8; the extra context edges are current-r3 item_11.
